source.lapis_dirty_scope: The qualification branch edits only the listed Lapis adapter, harness and documentation files. The Codex executable was built from the separate clean candidate revision before those Lapis edits.

scope: Codex P1 binary requalification for command approval and structured user input through protocol, TUI, service and desktop controls. It does not adopt the managed daemon or qualify two-thread worktrees or other request kinds.

failed_attempts.result: Two controlled runs each passed 11 preceding checks, then timed out waiting for two simultaneous approvals because this candidate exposed one approval at a time. Cleanup passed in both runs.
failed_attempts.repair: The harness now records observed admission and validates two distinct sequential approvals without weakening identity, fixture-command, turn-context or completion checks.

limitations: Only command approvals and structured user input are response-qualified.
The candidate's two approvals were sequential; its simultaneous-pending behavior is not claimed.
No managed-daemon adoption, P4 launch-contract decision, two-thread worktree probe, native hooks, importer onboarding, Linux, package, native input or GPU qualification.
The full aggregate and sanitizer runs cover this source but are not performance or package qualification.
